name: ResidualsParticipationsCalculator
tagline: Calculate talent residuals and backend participations, approve them and issue payee statements – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete participations desk for studios, streamers, distributors, producers and talent agencies: percent, net-profit, tiered and fixed formulas per exhibition window and period, caps, advance recoupment and withholding, a review and approval workflow with segregation of duties and second approvals, disputes, and payee statements with statement numbers. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen and connects to any collection, Dataverse, SharePoint or SQL table through column mappings.
features: Percent of gross / net, marginal tier bands, fixed amounts
Segregation of duties and second approval above a threshold
Payee statements per period with numbering, preview and copy
Bulk actions, CSV export, undo, confirmations
Phone layout with bottom view bar; keyboard and screen-reader support
Power Fx outputs and OnSave/OnCreate/OnStatusChange/OnAction events
